frozen_population_ledger.warning: The exact-beta candidate issue cycles are a reference proxy only. Conservative 4-bit coding changes the order, dropped prefix and bank populations; M336 does not reuse 3,787,146,191 as a measured route-B result.

four_bit_upper_bound_code.beta_definition: beta[layer,group,source] = max over the four destination rows of abs(symmetric-INT8 weight)
four_bit_upper_bound_code.encoding: code(beta) is the smallest c in [0,15] such that beta <= U[c]
four_bit_upper_bound_code.proof_obligation: For every encoded pair U[code(beta)] >= beta. U is monotone, so bucket order is nondecreasing in conservative upper beta.
four_bit_upper_bound_code.tie_break: The active-ID input is strictly ascending. Each bucket preserves arrival order, hence equal-code ties are stable in source-ID order.
four_bit_upper_bound_code.codebook_storage_reason: The 16 global constants are elaboration constants, not a learned per-layer table. A learned layer codebook would require new persistent bytes and a new DSE.

weight_static_compile_time: one 4-bit upper-beta code for every frozen layer/destination-group/source pair
fixed module-to-table-base map for the eleven frozen modules
source count and destination-group count for each frozen module
layer_static_runtime_configuration: one global 17-bit integer budget B in the frozen M328-compatible layout; a later per-layer-B extension would remain token-static but adds separately debited CSR state
module ID, destination-group ID and beta-table base supplied by the existing execution descriptor
group-major scheduling mode required to amortize beta scratchpad prefetch
token_dynamic: ascending active source IDs and valid count
per-bucket packed source IDs, partial-word counts and read/write pointers
cutoff-found flag, dropped count and kept count
kept suffix reservoir and eight bank-valid/source-channel issue bundle
ping-pong context ownership, token/group tag and ready/valid state
static_vs_dynamic_fields.explicit_non_feature: B itself does not change token by token in this predesign. Token dynamism comes from active membership and cumulative consumption, which can change the keep/drop decision of the same static source/group pair.

persistent_pair_table.layout: Dense group-major nibbles; source ID is the lookup address and the eleven frozen bases are compile-time constants.

current_group_beta_scratchpad.ports: fill mode: one 256-bit write per cycle; capture mode: eight independent 4-bit combinational reads per cycle
current_group_beta_scratchpad.implementation_boundary: Distributed registers or a custom multi-read register file, not a claimed single-port SRAM macro. Its eight-read mux area and 3 ns timing must be synthesized.

ping_pong_bucket_state.per_context_word_ram: 16 buckets x 56 words x 84 bits, where a word is eight 10-bit source IDs plus a 4-bit valid count
ping_pong_bucket_state.logical_ports: Sixteen banks shared by two disjoint context partitions; each bank is logical 112 x 84 1R1W. Capture may write one word to each of at most eight distinct bucket banks per cycle; drain reads one current-bucket word per cycle.

metadata_and_working_storage.physical_warning: All byte counts are logical, before SRAM compiler aspect-ratio rounding, ECC, spare rows, decoders and multi-read logic. Only the persistent pair table is the M333 exactly-4x metadata statement; including runtime state is 4.158x.

persistent_beta_sram.logical_port: 1R, 256 bits per cycle, sequential group prefetch
persistent_beta_sram.schedule_requirement: Process tokens/output positions group-major. Token-major group switching would charge up to 14 prefetch cycles per task and is not admitted.

beta_scratchpad.lookup_rate: eight arbitrary active IDs per cycle
beta_scratchpad.write_port: one 256-bit sequential fill port, mutually exclusive with lookup mode

bucket_ram.note: The 672-bit peak is distributed over at most eight of sixteen banks and includes writing previously buffered partial IDs; useful new input payload is at most eight (10-bit ID + 4-bit code) records, or 112 bits/cycle.

c2_k8_boundary.reuse_point: the fixed-bank group/request boundary downstream of M184, not M184's FC2-specific descriptor-window decoder
c2_k8_boundary.signals: valid/ready, tag, destination group/output block, source_count, bank_valid[7:0], source_channel[0:7]
c2_k8_boundary.adapter: A 16-entry elastic suffix reservoir selects the earliest buffered ID per source_id mod 8 bank and emits at most one source per bank per cycle. It preserves per-bank source order and accepts an arbitrary bucket word with bank collisions.
c2_k8_boundary.coexistence: A route mux selects legacy M184 groups or M336 groups before the M186 request slot. M184/M185/M186 remain unmodified in this milestone; a later wrapper must prove the parameterized destination-lane width and accumulator semantics.

capture: Require each accepted eight-lane active-ID bundle to be strictly ascending across valid lanes and across cycles.
Read eight 4-bit codes from the current-group scratchpad.
For every code c, stable-compact matching lanes into that bucket's partial eight-ID word.
At most eight new IDs enter one bucket in a cycle, so a partial word can emit at most one full 84-bit word and retain at most seven IDs; one write port per bucket is sufficient.
Reject more than 448 active IDs and do not publish a partially built context.
drain_and_budget: Drain bucket codes 0 through 15; within a bucket drain packed words in arrival order.
For a word with k IDs and decoded U, compute d=min(k,floor((B-S)/U)); define d=k when U=0. Drop the first d IDs and update S=S+d*U.
If d<k, the first kept source is the cutoff. Keep the remaining IDs in the word and every later source without further drop decisions.
Feed the kept suffix into the bank reservoir while the K8 engine drains up to one source per bank each cycle.
stable_bucket_algorithm.no_general_multiplier: d is 0..8 and U is seven bits; d*U is a small shift/add or table operation. The cumulative accumulator is 17 bits because 864*127=109728.
stable_bucket_algorithm.stability_proof: Monotone bucket code plus stable source-ID order within a bucket is exactly stable ascending (conservative upper beta, source ID). The computed d is the maximal prefix of each same-U word that fits the residual budget, so the concatenated dropped set is the maximal ordered active prefix under the conservative code.

error_bound_and_accuracy.integer_bound: For destination j in group g and dropped active prefix D, abs(sum_i_in_D Wq[j,i]) <= sum_i_in_D abs(Wq[j,i]) <= sum_i_in_D beta[i,g] <= sum_i_in_D U[code(i,g)] = S <= B.
error_bound_and_accuracy.conservative_code_effect: The code never understates beta, so quantization cannot violate the M328 raw signed INT8 accumulator bound. It can only alter ordering and consume budget more quickly, generally reducing opportunity.
error_bound_and_accuracy.b0_strict_bypass: When B=0, bypass beta lookup and buckets and send every active source to the legacy K8 route. No source is dropped, selector overhead is zero, and the result is bit-exact to the sparse baseline.
error_bound_and_accuracy.b0_optional_lossless_subset: Sources with exact beta=0 are an additional provably lossless subset, but using the coded route to find them incurs selector work and is not the default M328 B0 contract.

gpu_accuracy_required.reason: A bounded raw INT8 accumulator perturbation does not prove post-scale, BN, ATLIF threshold, recurrent state or optical-flow AEE/AAE behavior. M301 already showed an accumulator-bound candidate can fail the software budget, and Phi PAFT likewise reports a minor accuracy decrease for an approximate hardware-aware path.

definitions.A: active sources for one token/destination-group task
definitions.n_c: active sources encoded into bucket c
definitions.drain_R: sum over 16 buckets of ceil(n_c/8), omitting empty buckets
definitions.fragmentation_F: R-C, with 0 <= F <= 14 for at most sixteen nonempty buckets and eight-ID words

per_task.reason_average_is_interval: M328 did not log 4-bit bucket populations. An exact R average requires the new conservative-code CPU replay and must not be fabricated from exact-beta results.

cross_task_ping_pong_steady_state.formula: max(C,R,Q4) plus group fill/drain and prefetch
cross_task_ping_pong_steady_state.claim_boundary: This is a lower-bound proxy, not executable M336 cycles.

necessary_without_fill_drain: capture C=4,808,840,856 is already below the limit
integrated bucket-to-bank-reservoir-to-K8 schedule, not just max(Q4,R4), must remain <= the limit
one_point_fifteen_conditions.interpretation: The 4-bit CPU schedule DSE must show average bucket fragmentation below about one cycle per task and must separately show that conservative coding plus bank conflicts do not raise Q4/integrated service above the same 1.15x limit. These are necessary gates, not present measurements.

modules.name: m336_beta_group_prefetch_scratchpad
modules.responsibility: Sequentially prefetch one group of 4-bit codes from the persistent table and provide eight arbitrary combinational code lookups per capture cycle.

modules.name: m336_bucket16_pingpong_builder
modules.responsibility: Accept eight ascending active IDs/cycle, stable-pack sixteen code buckets, enforce 448-active capacity and publish complete ping-pong contexts.

modules.name: m336_cumulative_cutoff_drain
modules.responsibility: Drain buckets in code order, apply the 17-bit conservative prefix budget, audit drop/keep counts and stream the kept suffix.

modules.name: m336_k8_bank_reservoir_adapter
modules.responsibility: Buffer a small suffix window, choose the earliest source per modulo-eight bank and emit the existing fixed-bank group protocol under backpressure.

modules.name: m336_selector_k8_route_mux
modules.responsibility: Select exact B0/legacy M184 traffic or M336 traffic before the M186 request slot without modifying the legacy blocks.

out_of_scope: weight SRAM macros and physical floorplan
BN, ATLIF and output commit integration
RTL, VCS, DC, Formality, PT and PTPX execution in M336

vcs_acceptance_for_next_milestone.tool: Synopsys VCS with SVA; no Verilator substitution
must_pass: B0 bypass bit-exact bundle and Acc result miter against the legacy K8 route under randomized ready/valid stalls
software-reference miter for all sixteen code endpoints, budget crossings inside every word lane, U=0, all-one-bucket, all-sixteen-bucket and full 448-active cases
same-bank collision stress proving at most one issued source per bank per cycle and no source loss, duplication or reordering within a bank
ping-pong overlap with arbitrary capture/drain/K8 backpressure and group transitions
fail-closed attacks for nonascending IDs, more than 448 IDs, stale context reuse, premature group switch and reset during partial capture
cycle counters equal accepted capture beats, packed bucket words, K8 issue beats and explicit stalls
mandatory_assertions: U(code) >= beta for every fixture pair
all dropped IDs precede all kept IDs in stable conservative order
after cutoff no later source is dropped
context is published only after all partial words flush
no context bank is overwritten before retirement
B0 accepts no selector lookup and emits every active source

dc_acceptance_for_later_milestone.target: commercial TSMC28 library, 3.000 ns, exact-SHA SDC and library identity
logic_gate: setup and hold WNS >= 0 at the declared PVT
eight-read scratchpad mux, sixteen-way stable compaction, prefix budget and bank reservoir are included, not black-boxed as free logic
report selector-only, shared K8-only and selector-plus-K8 cell area, flop count, combinational area and critical path
memory_gate: Persistent beta table, 16 x 112 x 84 logical 1R1W bucket banks and scratchpad must be mapped to declared macros or explicitly reported as logical-only.
A logic-only DC pass is not paper PPA ready and cannot support area, power, energy or EDP claims.
Paper promotion requires macro area/energy, SAIF/PTPX activity, and same-resource baseline/candidate accounting.
dc_acceptance_for_later_milestone.performance_gate: The new CPU task scheduler and later RTL counter replay must both satisfy the 5,810,153,280-cycle 1.15x limit after prefetch, fill/drain, bank conflicts and stalls; a raw kept-source count is insufficient.

novelty_collision_check.adjacent_mechanism: Product sparsity, exact/partial pattern reuse, detector/TCAM, sorting/dispatch and reused partial products.
novelty_collision_check.difference: M336 does not match or reuse activation patterns or cached products. It spends a provable destination-group INT8 error budget over the current token's active subset and sends a conservative kept suffix to a bit-sparse K8 executor.
novelty_collision_check.risk: Bucket/sort/control and sparse-product skipping are conventional ingredients; they are not standalone contributions.

novelty_collision_check.adjacent_mechanism: Pattern-based hierarchical sparsity, pattern/codebook execution, PWP prefetch and PAFT accuracy/performance co-design.
novelty_collision_check.difference: M336's 4-bit symbol encodes a conservative scalar weight bound per source/group, not a spike pattern or PWP. The runtime novelty witness is token-dependent prefix consumption for the same source/group pair.
novelty_collision_check.risk: Both use static codes to steer approximate work removal and therefore require an explicit claim chart and GPU accuracy; codebooks alone are not novel.

novelty_collision_check.adjacent_mechanism: Token-time bundle density stratification plus BSA/ECP approximate activity removal with an error argument.
novelty_collision_check.difference: M336 has one K8 sparse path, no dense/sparse dual-core stratifier, no BSA training distribution and no Q/K/S/V/Y bundle pruning. Its proof is a per-destination-group symmetric-INT8 triangle bound and its decision is a token-active cumulative prefix.
novelty_collision_check.risk: Error-bounded omission is close prior-art territory. Do not claim first or treat ping-pong/bucketing as novelty without a formula-level primary-paper claim chart.

novelty_position.conditionally_defensible_composite: Weight-static four-bit conservative destination-group bounds plus a token-active cumulative cutoff with a same-source cross-token decision witness, coupled to a fixed-bank bit-sparse executor.
novelty_position.claim_gate: Do not promote M336 to a paper contribution until conservative-code DSE, GPU accuracy, executable RTL cycles, mapped memory-inclusive PPA and a primary-paper formula-level Bishop/Phi/Prosperity claim chart all pass.

findings.finding: The 4-bit bucket population and conservative-code K8 issue ledger do not exist yet.
findings.impact: Average drain cycles are bounded, not measured; the optimistic 1.3895x proxy cannot be called route-B performance.
findings.required_fix: Run a frozen CPU replay that emits per-task n_c, R, cutoff rank, dropped IDs and kept bank populations, then execute the explicit ping-pong/bank-reservoir schedule.

findings.finding: Eight arbitrary 4-bit reads are realized by a 432-byte distributed multi-read scratchpad, not by the 498,816-byte single-port metadata SRAM.
findings.impact: The route is port-feasible only under group-major prefetch and can lose timing/area in the eight-read mux.
findings.required_fix: Synthesize the scratchpad and prove the group-major execution/activation traffic contract before RTL promotion.

findings.finding: The 16-bank 19,232-byte ping-pong store is a logical organization without target SRAM macros.
findings.impact: Macro rounding and 1R1W port energy can erase the issue-cycle opportunity even if functional RTL passes.
findings.required_fix: Select target macros or a register-file implementation and include area, energy and timing in the same-resource comparison.

findings.finding: B>0 remains an approximate algorithm despite the integer bound.
findings.impact: BN/ATLIF threshold and recurrent-state effects can amplify bounded local error.
findings.required_fix: After CPU schedule admission, run paired modified-forward S10 and then valid825 before any paper or RTL promotion.

findings.finding: The exact 4x persistent footprint relies on the fixed eleven-module layout and existing descriptor addresses.
findings.impact: A standalone generalized module directory or learned per-layer codebook adds bytes beyond 4x.
findings.required_fix: Keep the frozen layout claim scoped or debit every generalized descriptor/codebook byte in a new footprint gate.

findings.finding: M184 is FC2 descriptor-window logic and cannot be reused unchanged as this selector frontend.
findings.impact: Only the downstream fixed-bank group/request protocol is reusable; wrapper and parameterized LANES behavior remain unproved.
findings.required_fix: Build the route mux and a parameterized K8 wrapper, then VCS-miter legacy and M336 routes.

findings.finding: The local novelty check is bounded and Bishop remains high-risk adjacent prior art.
findings.impact: The composite can be described as a candidate but not as first or collision-free.
findings.required_fix: Before writing the contribution claim, produce a formula-level primary-source claim chart and citation-chain review.

scorecard.interpretation: Strong enough to admit one CPU schedule/DSE milestone. Not strong enough for RTL, Synopsys, GPU accuracy or a DATE contribution claim.

required_next: Implement a CPU-only conservative-code replay using the frozen M328 inputs and the exact U[0..15] table in this predesign.
Emit n_c, C, R, cutoff, dynamic witness, kept bank populations, reservoir occupancy/stalls and group-boundary overhead for every task.
Kill the route unless bound violations remain zero, B0 bypass is exact, dynamic witness is nonzero and the integrated group4 total including 15,696 prefetch cycles is <=5,810,153,280.
Only after that pass, request a separate GPU accuracy milestone; RTL/VCS/DC remain later gates.
